q: According to the Red Book 2017, until when may Variations be initiated by the Engineer?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Only during the first half of the Time for Completion

choices.label: B
choices.text: Any time until the Performance Certificate

choices.label: D
choices.text: Any time before the issue of the Taking-Over Certificate for the Works

choices.label: D
